categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land title settlement processes, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
